page_title: HAV 1-2 BRE | Le Havre v Brest 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Florent Batta is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Axel Camblan (Brest) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florent Batta had an easy-decision to make.
88' Andy Logbo (Le Havre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
87' The referee blows his whistle as Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) was too aggressive in his challenge.
87' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremy Le Douaron departs the field of play to be replaced by Axel Camblan (Brest).
84' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Abdoulaye Toure and he is replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
83' Substitution. Romain Del Castillo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Hiang'a Mbock (Brest).
82' A cross from a corner kick by Le Havre is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
81' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
79' The current number of shots on goal is 6:4.
77' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
75' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' Andy Logbo (Le Havre) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
73' Substitution. Hugo Magnetti will be replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
67' Here is a change. Rassoul Ndiaye is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) replaces Issa Soumare.
66' The game has come to an end for Nabil Alioui. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Andy Logbo (Le Havre).
66' Superb touch by Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save!
64' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
62' Bradley Locko (Brest) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
60' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonas Martin (Brest) replacing Mahdi Camara.
60' Substitution. Martin Satriano walks off the pitch and Steve Mounie (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
56' 1 - 2 Lilian Brassier (Brest) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header into the roof of the net from close range. The score is 1:2.
55' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will take the corner.
55' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for an infringement.
52' 1 - 1 Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
52' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Bizot, who smothers the ball.
49' Florent Batta couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Hugo Magnetti (Brest) and blew his whistle.
47' Mahdi Camara (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Florent Batta and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' Substitution. Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) has come on for Josue Casimir.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Florent Batta has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:3.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
43' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
40' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!

38' Martin Satriano (Brest) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florent Batta with no other option than to blow for a foul.
36' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
34' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
31' Martin Satriano (Brest) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
28' 0 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Romain Del Castillo (Brest) unleashes a shot straight inside the left post. Good team effort!
28' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Florent Batta has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
27' Martin Satriano (Brest) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
23' Kenny Lala (Brest) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

20' Brest slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
18' Florent Batta has a clear sight and sees a foul from Issa Soumare (Le Havre).
16' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
15' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
13' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
11' A pass by Hugo Magnetti (Brest) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
9' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
8' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
6' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
5' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
3' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Florent Batta is introduced as the referee for today's match.
